annotation_method: Approximate nonexpert source-image corner selections, before this camera fit; not automatic detection or measured geometry
uncertainty_scope: An authored annotation envelope, not a calibrated confidence interval
face_hypothesis: The wide bright face is the cuboid top and the narrow dark face is its +x side; positive x projects right. Both depth-axis signs are retained.
dimensions_source: Unchanged selected-coast scene; width/height are conditional front-view fits and depth is authored
initial_pose_assumption: The target has not moved between side frame 0 and front frame 8
limitations: Corner identity and top/side assignments are explicit hypotheses, not independently verified 3D observations.
Rounded edges, shadows, lens distortion and perspective can change the selected apparent corners.
These points are not the four corners of a minimum-area silhouette rectangle.
This first trial is exposed development evidence; the separate repeat trial is not used.
